resources.string: Use biometrics or your device credentials
Unlock the app to continue with scans, imports, and shared files.
Biometric or device credential authentication is not available on this device
Set up biometrics or a device screen lock before enabling app protection

Enable biometric protection in Settings → Security. The app locks automatically after the configured background timeout (default: 30 s). Use fingerprint, face recognition, or your device PIN to unlock. Incoming shortcuts and shared files are queued until the app is unlocked. The lock is a UI gate only — it does not encrypt documents or the database.

An optional biometric app lock (Settings → Security) locks the UI after a configurable background timeout. Authentication uses Android\'s BiometricManager; the app itself does not store or process biometric data.

The optional biometric lock is a UI gate and does not encrypt documents or the database. Biometric verification is handled by Android\'s BiometricManager; the app never accesses fingerprint or face data directly. The setting is stored locally in SharedPreferences.
